manuscript.title: Sharp entropy-budget laws for Gaussian reset channels
manuscript.author: Lluis Eriksson

recommendation_meaning: Scientific recommendation for minor revision; not editorial admission, human peer review or correctness certificate.

importance_airr.scale_kind: high-ceiling research importance; not correctness probability or percentage
importance_airr.rationale: Very good specialized contribution with strong unassisted arbitrary-block converse, entropy-budget uniformity and sharp necessity; no evidence of field-changing importance or worldwide priority.

technical_quality.rationale: Elaborate analytic proof withstands the specific tests performed, including operational and uniformity issues; remains conditional on imported theorems and nonformal review.

profile.basis: Main chains, signs and domains checked; sources match imported claims; no counterexample found. Full foundational proofs and formal certification absent.
Mixed references, summed entropy minimum, shared cost, infinite-state compression and order of limits addressed. Some definitions and citation/version presentation merit clarification.

Averaged arbitrary-block converse, unassisted law, necessity and enlarged Gaussian family are substantive relative to reviewed antecedents. Curve and much machinery are prior; search is not exhaustive and Baitenov full text was inaccessible.
Strong asymptotic quantifiers in a specialized phase-insensitive Gaussian class; no critical curve, efficient finite blocklength, arbitrary squeezing or unbounded gain result.
Frozen inputs, full source, six byte-identical reruns and archived primary-source hashes. No independent implementation or formal verification.

material_objections_meaning: No invalidating defect found within written scope; not proof that none exists.
